project.title: CarbonNova — AI-Powered Agricultural Carbon Intelligence & Marketplace
project.short_description: A role-based carbon project platform where sellers register land and submit projects, buyers assess and purchase eligible demo credits, and admins govern verification — with IBM Db2 persistence, transactional credit allocation, and LangChain-assisted grounded AI workflows.

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker / Db2 Developer Extension)
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db (Node.js) with parameterized SQL and transactional workflows
features_used: Health check via SELECT CURRENT SERVER FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

ai_models: OpenAI-compatible model via LangChain (configurable; e.g. Nebius/NVIDIA Nemotron)
